lesson.text:
Leave without anger.
Don't stay tied.
lesson.basis: Great Image 君子以遠小人，不惡而嚴 (the noble one keeps away from petty people, not with hatred but with firmness); line 4 Wang Bi 君子好遯，故能舍之，小人繫戀 (the noble one can let go; the petty one stays clinging); line 3 係遯…不能遠害 (tied while retreating, he cannot get clear of harm)

finding.text:
LINE 4: A GOOD RETREAT.
HE LETS GO; THE PETTY CLING.
finding.basis: 九四，好遯，君子吉，小人否 (a retreat he is fond of: good for the noble one, not for the petty one); Wang Bi 故能舍之，小人繫戀 (so he can let go; the petty one clings)

shorts.note: Retreat is about the manner of leaving: firm distance without hatred, and not staying bound (line 3) the way the petty do (line 4). The meaning card 'No anger, just distance' already has this; the lesson should carry it rather than timing alone.

issues: finding lacks reason: 'FOUR STRONG LINES PUSH UP' is shape only

finding.text:
LINE 3: RAM BUTTS THE FENCE.
ITS OWN FORCE TRAPS IT.
finding.basis: 九三，小人用壯，君子用罔…羝羊觸藩，羸其角 (the petty use their strength, the noble do not… the ram butts the fence and its horns get caught); Wang Bi 君子用之以為羅己者也 (the noble one sees such strength as a net around himself)

shorts.note: The lesson sits on the Tuan 大者正也 (greatness is being correct) and the Great Image 非禮弗履 (do not tread where it isn't right); it answers 'Finally in charge?'. Only the readout needs the reason.

lesson.text:

finding.text:
AT THE TOP: HORNS FIRST.
ITS WAY DOES NOT YET SHINE.
finding.basis: 上九，晉其角，維用伐邑 (advancing with the horns, only fit to attack a town); Small Image 道未光也 (the way is not yet bright); Wang Bi 已在乎角，而猶進之，非亢如何 (already at the horn yet still pushing: what is that if not excess?)

shorts.note: Progress is advance that comes from being bright and compliant (順而麗乎大明), so others raise you (the lord given horses, received three times a day). Pushing by force (line 6) shows the light hasn't come through yet.

lesson.text:
Hide your light.

lesson.basis: Tuan 內文明而外柔順…晦其明也，內難而能正其志 (bright within, yielding without… darken the light; in inner hardship keep the aim correct); line 5 Small Image 箕子之貞，明不可息也 (Jizi's steadiness: the light cannot be put out). Fits the crescent that stays lit.

shorts.note: The animation already shows the deeper half (the crescent stays lit); the lesson text stops at the dimming. Meaning card 2 'Keep your light inside' is close, so the new lesson could replace it or the card could shift to Great Image 用晦而明 (use the dark and stay bright).

lesson.text:
Out of danger?

lesson.basis: Great Image 雷雨作，解，君子以赦過宥罪 (thunder and rain: release; the noble one pardons faults and forgives offences); Judgment 有攸往，夙吉 (if there is somewhere to go, go early)

finding.text:
LINE 5: THE NOBLE ONE LETS GO.
EVEN THE PETTY HOLD NO GRUDGE.
finding.basis: 六五，君子維有解，吉。有孚于小人 (the noble one alone can release; he wins trust even from petty people); Wang Bi 小人雖闇，猶知服之而无怨矣 (though the petty are dull, they still yield and bear no grudge)

shorts.note: Deliverance is release after hardship: pardon, untie what's knotted, and go on promptly. The current lesson keeps only the 'promptly' half and drops the forgiving that the cards set up.

Let your gain spill
to those below you.
lesson.basis: Tuan 益，損上益下，民說无疆 (increase: taking from above to add below, the people's joy has no bounds); line 5 有孚惠心 (sincere kindness of heart); line 6 Wang Bi 求益无已…人弗與也 (seeking gain without end, no one gives to him)

shorts.note: The lesson's centre is right (gain flows downward), but the short sets up 'door's open, go' and never links it. Either the hook moves toward sharing ('Things going your way?') or the lesson names who the gain goes to, as proposed; the bowl animation fits both.

lesson.text:
Call it out in the open.
Force makes enemies.
lesson.basis: Judgment 揚于王庭…不利即戎 (proclaim it in the king's court… taking up arms does not serve); commentary 若用剛即戎，尚力取勝，為物所疾 (if you go to arms and win by force, others come to hate you); Tuan 決而和 (decisive yet in harmony)

shorts.note: Breakthrough is decisive action done openly and without violence; the reason in the text is that winning by force turns people against you. The current lesson is right but gives the act without that reason.

shorts.note: One yielding line meets five strong ones and will grow; the text's reason for checking it early is that it cannot be lived with long. The current lesson has the reason in 'while it's small'; the rewrite ties it to the hook.

lesson.text:
Towns move. The well stays.
Be that steady.
lesson.basis: Tuan 改邑不改井，乃以剛中也 (the town changes, the well doesn't, because it is firm at the centre); commentary 井用有常德 (the well works by constant virtue); 井養而不窮 (it nourishes without running out)

shorts.note: The well is the steady source the town depends on; its warning (汔至亦未繘井，羸其瓶, the jar broken just short of the top) is about finishing what you start. An option that answers the hook: 'The water is there.\nDon't stop short.'
